description: Source code for SEC OpenMAX IL Core implementation, managing component registration, handle management, and role queries for multimedia components on Samsung devices.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_Init
methods.description: Initializes the OpenMAX core, registers components, and sets up resource management.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_Deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the core, unregisters components, and releases resources.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_ComponentNameEnum
methods.description: Enumerates available component names by index.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_GetHandle
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to a component by name, loading and setting callbacks.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_FreeHandle
methods.description: Frees a component handle and unloads the component.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_SetupTunnel
methods.description: Sets up tunneling between components (not implemented).

methods.name: SEC_OMX_GetContentPipe
methods.description: Gets a content pipe handle for a URI (not implemented).

methods.name: SEC_OMX_GetComponentsOfRole
methods.description: Retrieves list of component names supporting a specific role.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_GetRolesOfComponent
methods.description: Retrieves list of roles supported by a specific component.
